*Relief for TMJ pain, headaches, and jaw tension, plus refined cosmetic dentistry. Austin's private dental atelier led by Dr. Kevin Winters. Book a consultation.*


[  ](/assets/videos/hero-video.mp4)

— A Private Wellness Atelier in Austin

# Not Dentistry. A Return to Yourself.

At **The Hills Dental Spa**, nothing begins with teeth. It begins with how you feel when tension is gone, when confidence is quiet and natural, when your body no longer resists you. Set in Austin and serving West Lake Hills, Rollingwood, Lost Creek, and Lakeway, this is a private environment for those who value precision, discretion, and outcomes that don't need explanation.

Some arrive after years of searching. Others simply expect more. Both find something rare.

[Request My Consultation](/contact-us)  [(512) 347-0044](tel:+15123470044)

TMJ & ESTHETIC MASTERY

## TMJ. The Hidden Weight You Were Never Meant to Carry.

There is a certain kind of exhaustion that doesn't show—but it's always there. In your jaw. In your sleep. In your focus. Most learn to live with it. Adjust to it. Work around it. **We don't.** Our work centers on a highly specialized, non-surgical system guided by advanced computer-based diagnostics designed to uncover the exact source of imbalance with precision, not assumption.


[[Image: TMJ Therapy & Diagnostics]](/services/general-dentistry/tmj-therapy)

### [TMJ & Neuromuscular Therapy](/services/general-dentistry/tmj-therapy)

Explore TMJ Therapy and Neuromuscular Dentistry—where discomfort is not managed, but resolved at its origin. Guided by advanced computer-based diagnostics, our system resolves chronic jaw, sleep, and neck tension. For many, this becomes the moment everything shifts—from enduring to living.

[Explore TMJ Therapy](/services/general-dentistry/tmj-therapy)

[[Image: Refined Aesthetic Work]](/services/cosmetic-dentistry)

### [Aesthetic Work & Cosmetic Design](/services/cosmetic-dentistry)

True luxury is invisible. It doesn't announce itself—it's understood. Our approach to Cosmetic Dentistry follows the same philosophy found in fine design and high jewelry: proportion, balance, restraint. Nothing excessive. Nothing artificial. Only what belongs. The outcome is the smile that was always meant to be there—effortless, composed, and entirely your own.

[Explore Cosmetic](/services/cosmetic-dentistry)

[[Image: The Private Atelier Experience]](/about/virtual-tour)

### [A Private Standard of Care](/about/virtual-tour)

Everything here is intentional. Nothing is incidental. Set in a private, fee-for-service environment, our clinic is structured to provide absolute freedom in care recommendations. This is not about amenities; it's about how carefully an experience can be designed when every single detail matters.

[View Atelier Experience](/about/virtual-tour)

[  ](/assets/videos/Background%20Video.mp4)

THE ATELIER EXPERIENCE

## Designed Like a Private Atelier

Everything here is intentional. Nothing is incidental. From the moment you arrive, the environment shifts—quiet, controlled, and deeply personal. Time slows. External noise fades. The experience becomes yours alone.

[Step Inside Through Our Virtual Tour](/about/virtual-tour)

01

### Private Treatment Suites

Isolated, private care environments designed to establish absolute quiet and security. Your treatment suites are completely private and never shared.

02

### Aromatherapy & Weight

Carefully chosen premium organic essential oils and weighted physiological comfort wraps designed specifically to calm and balance the nervous system.

03

### Heated Support & Curated Sound

Ergonomic heated support systems combined with acoustic sound design and custom visual environments, removing clinical noise and triggers completely.

04

### In-Room Massage Options

Enhance your wellness experience with an optional medical massage therapy session, seamlessly integrated before or during your dental treatments.

PATIENT SMILES

## Results That Speak *Quietly*

The most meaningful changes are often the least visible. A relaxed jaw. Deeper sleep. A sense of ease that carries into every conversation, every room, every moment.

[SMILE GALLERY](/about/smile-gallery) [REVIEWS](/about/reviews)

[Image: Patient Smile 1]

[Image: Patient Smile 2]

[Image: Patient Smile 3]

[Image: Patient Smile 4]

[Image: Patient Smile 5]

[Image: Patient Smile 6]

MASTERY, WITHOUT DISPLAY

## Meet Dr. Kevin Winters

Guiding each experience is **Dr. Kevin Winters**, whose work has influenced thousands of clinicians globally in the fields of aesthetic and neuromuscular dentistry. His approach is deliberate, exacting, and quietly obsessive in its pursuit of precision—where function and beauty are never treated as separate ideas.

[MEET DR. WINTERS](/about/meet-the-doctor)

[Image: Dr. Kevin Winters, DDS]

A PRIVATE STANDARD

## A Private Standard of Care

This is a fee-for-service practice by design—allowing complete freedom in how care is recommended and delivered. No limitations. No compromises. Only what is right for you. Flexible arrangements are available through **CareCredit, Cherry, and Proceed Finance**.

[Image: The Hills Dental Spa Elegant Operatory]

[Image: Atelier Calm Consultation Lounge]

[Image: Advanced Physiological Equipment]

[Image: Sensory Spa Treatments Room]

[Get Directions to the Austin Atelier](https://maps.app.goo.gl/mQDY5bJy5qEoXCou5) [PATIENT INFORMATION](/patient-info)

YOUR QUESTIONS ANSWERED

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Is TMJ therapy surgical?


No. Our TMJ work focuses entirely on non-surgical, physiological systems guided by advanced, computer-based diagnostics to locate and resolve the exact origin of neuromuscular tension.

### What is a fee-for-service practice?


It means we operate independently of insurance-driven limits. We are not restricted in the time we spend with you, the quality of dental materials we use, or the advanced procedures we recommend. You receive pure, uncompromised care.

### Are financing arrangements available?


Yes. While we are a private, fee-for-service clinic, we partner with leading premium medical finance providers including CareCredit, Cherry, and Proceed Finance to make your treatment plan comfortable and seamless.

### Where is the practice located?


Our private atelier is located in Austin, TX, and we proudly serve clients from West Lake Hills, Rollingwood, Lost Creek, Lakeway, and beyond who seek a higher standard of care.

TAKE THE FIRST STEP

## Begin, When You're Ready

There comes a point where waiting no longer makes sense—where discomfort, limitation, or hesitation is no longer acceptable. This is where that changes.

content.markdown:
*Learn more about Dr. Kevin Winters of The Hills Dental Spa in Austin, TX. Discover the visionary approach behind his advanced cosmetic and TMJ care.*


[Image: The Hills Dental Spa Consultation Lounge]

— THE VISIONARY BEHIND THE ATELIER

# Meet Dr. Kevin Winters

A Vision That Goes Beyond Dentistry

[Image: Dr. Kevin Winters]

Dr. Kevin Winters Doctor of Dental Surgery & Educator

OUR FOUNDING PRINCIPLE

## At The Hills Dental Spa, the experience you receive is a reflection of the vision behind it. That vision belongs to Dr. Kevin Winters—whose drive for excellence goes far beyond technique.

His mission has always been to create something different. Something lasting. Something that truly elevates the lives of those he serves.

[Image: The Hills Dental Spa Clinical Philosophy background]

CLINICAL PHILOSOPHY

## The Pursuit of Perfection

For more than 30 years, Dr. Kevin Winters has led practices that reflect a deep commitment to both technical mastery and patient-focused care. From the physical design of the space to the clinical protocols used in treatment, everything about his approach is built to serve one goal: delivering exceptional, life-enhancing results with intention and integrity.

Since 2017, that vision has been brought to life in Austin. Patients come to Dr. Winters for [cosmetic transformations](/services/cosmetic-dentistry), [TMJ therapy](/services/general-dentistry/tmj-therapy), and [neuromuscular treatment](/services/general-dentistry/neuromuscular-dentistry) because they’ve heard what sets his care apart—and they’re ready for answers other providers couldn’t deliver.

[Explore Our Clinical Excellence](/services)

CLINICAL LEADERSHIP

## Credentials That Inform, Not Define

Dr. Winters’ dual passion for both aesthetic artistry and functional harmony has led to his recognition as one of the top clinical educators in the world of advanced cosmetic dentistry.

"Titles aren’t what motivate him—results are."

01

### Doctor of Dental Surgery

University of Missouri–Kansas City

02

### Clinical Instructor

Las Vegas Institute for Advanced Dental Studies (since 1997)

03

### Program Director

LVI Global (Current Position)

04

### Global Mentorship

Mentor to 10,000+ dentists across 52 countries

05

### Author & Speaker

National speaker and published author on advanced dental and neuromuscular techniques

BEYOND THE PRACTICE

## Driven By More Than Dentistry

01

### Kansas State Football

Before dentistry, there was competition. As a former college football player at Kansas State University, Dr. Winters knows what it means to commit fully and challenge himself every single day.

02

### Bodybuilding at 60

In 2023, he successfully competed in two bodybuilding competitions at the age of 60—a personal milestone that showcases his mental discipline, drive, and exceptional character.

03

### Global Mentorship

That same relentless growth mindset drives him to share his expertise. Dr. Winters regularly mentors other doctors and lectures nationally on advanced neuromuscular dental techniques.

04

### Unwinding & Resetting

When he is not in the treatment room, he and his wife, Mindi, love to travel. Finding a pristine beach allows him to quiet the mind, recharge his focus, and return to his craft inspired.

THE ATELIER STANDARD

## The Difference Is in the Details

The trust patients place in Dr. Winters is rooted in how he makes them feel—heard, understood, and genuinely cared for. Whether you are seeking cosmetic refinement or physiological restoration,
you'll receive care that is precise and personal.

01 / AESTHETICS

### Porcelain Veneers

Meticulously engineered and individually characterized veneers designed to complement your natural features and restore perfect alignment.

[Learn About Veneers →](/services/cosmetic-dentistry/porcelain-veneers)

02 / PHYSIOLOGICAL

### Sleep Apnea Treatment

Customized, non-surgical oral appliances that keep the airway open during sleep, helping you wake up refreshed and fully restored.

[Sleep Treatment →](/services/general-dentistry/sleep-apnea-treatment)

03 / FUNCTION

### Full Mouth Reconstruction

A total harmonization of aesthetic artistry and physical bite alignment, resetting neuromuscular joints to relieve persistent pain.

[Bite Restoration →](/services/restorative-dentistry/full-mouth-reconstruction)

SERVICE RECOGNITION AREAS

Austin, TX | West Lake Hills | Rollingwood | Lost Creek | Lakeway, TX

TAKE THE FIRST STEP

## Begin, When You're Ready

There comes a point where waiting no longer makes sense—where discomfort, limitation, or hesitation is no longer acceptable. This is where that changes.

[Request My Consultation](/contact-us)  [Call (512) 347-0044](tel:+15123470044)

*Custom veneers by Dr. Winters, LVI Program Director. Natural results lasting 20+ years. Free consultation. Serving Austin, Westlake & Bee Cave.*


[Image: Porcelain veneers at The Hills Dental Spa in Austin, TX]

— OUR SERVICES

# Porcelain Veneers in Austin, TX

A Refined Approach to Smile Transformation

Porcelain veneers at [**The Hills Dental Spa**](/about) are not just about perfecting the appearance of your teeth—they're about unlocking the version of yourself that feels most confident, composed, and complete. Whether you're preparing for a career move, life event, or simply ready to stop hiding your smile, veneers offer a seamless path to transformation.

This is a curated, luxury-level service designed for individuals who value discretion, detail, and results that feel effortless.

## What Porcelain Veneers Can Do

Porcelain veneers are thin, custom-crafted shells bonded to the front of your teeth. They are ideal for correcting:

* ◆ Discoloration that resists whitening
* ◆ Uneven spacing or gaps
* ◆ Chips, cracks, or worn enamel
* ◆ Irregular shapes or asymmetry
* ◆ Mild alignment issues

The final result is subtle yet striking. Veneers reflect light like natural enamel and are color-matched to your overall facial tone—not just your teeth. The goal isn’t to make you look different. It’s to make you look like you, only brighter.

## Thoughtful Design, Meticulous Execution

We don’t approach veneers as a cosmetic fix. We see them as a functional art form. Your facial features, lip line, skin tone, and bite are all factored into a design that’s uniquely yours.

At The Hills Dental Spa, we use premium materials and partner with elite dental labs to ensure the finest results. Every step—from the initial consult to the final placement—is handled with precision and privacy.

The experience is led by [**Dr. Kevin Winters**](/about/meet-the-doctor), whose expertise in both cosmetic and neuromuscular dentistry ensures your veneers not only look beautiful, but also feel natural and balanced in your bite.

## How Veneers Can Change More Than Your Smile

Custom porcelain veneers designed by [**Dr. Kevin Winters**](/about/meet-the-doctor), LVI Program Director, built to look natural and last 20 to 25 years or longer. For patients throughout Austin, West Lake Hills, and Lakeway, TX, veneers are often the turning point where a cosmetic upgrade becomes lasting confidence.

You’ll no longer second-guess your smile. You’ll lead with it.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How long do porcelain veneers last?


With excellent care, porcelain veneers can last 10 to 15 years or more. Their lifespan depends on oral hygiene habits and avoiding habits like teeth grinding or using teeth as tools.

### Are porcelain veneers painful to get?


Most patients experience little to no discomfort. A small amount of enamel is removed, but the process is gentle and typically requires only local anesthesia.

### Do veneers look natural?


Yes. High-quality veneers are crafted to match the translucency and shape of natural teeth. We carefully customize every detail to suit your smile and facial features.

### What’s the difference between veneers and crowns?


Veneers cover only the front surface of the tooth, ideal for cosmetic enhancements. Crowns cover the entire tooth and are used when more structural support is needed.

## Begin the Process. Change Everything.

If you’re ready for a refined, intelligent approach to porcelain veneers in Austin, we invite you to schedule a private consultation. We’ll listen to your goals, evaluate your smile, and map out a vision that feels effortless—yet entirely transformative.

Call The Hills Dental Spa at [**(512) 347-0044**](tel:+15123470044) or [**request an appointment**](/contact-us) today.

BEGIN YOUR ELEVATED EXPERIENCE

## Ready to Experience It for Yourself?

The first step is a conversation. We’ll guide you through every detail, every question, and every possibility with clarity and care.

EVERYDAY MASTERY

# General Dentistry in Austin, TX

OUR PHILOSOPHY

## Comprehensive Dental Care in a Boutique Setting

At [The Hills Dental Spa](/about), general dentistry is anything but routine. While many associate it with basic cleanings and checkups, our approach is rooted in prevention, early diagnosis, and elevated care—delivered in a setting that feels nothing like a traditional dental office.

We offer general dental services as a foundation for lifelong oral health. Whether you're visiting for a routine exam or addressing a functional concern, every appointment is designed to support total wellness with minimal stress. Our team takes time to understand your goals, evaluate your bite, and deliver care that prioritizes both comfort and performance. Patients from Austin, West Lake Hills, Rollingwood, Lost Creek, and Lakeway, TX trust us for general dentistry that prioritizes comfort, prevention, and long-term health.

CURATED TREATMENT INDEX

## A Refined Approach to Everyday Dentistry

General dentistry at The Hills Dental Spa supports more than just your teeth—it impacts how you sleep, speak, and experience life. We take a comprehensive view of oral health, with a focus on function, balance, and early intervention to prevent complex problems later on.

Explore our full range of **general dentistry services**:

01

### TMJ Therapy

This isn’t just treatment for the jaw. It’s relief that supports how you live, sleep, and function every day.

[Learn More](/services/general-dentistry/tmj-therapy)

02

### Neuromuscular Dentistry

We don’t just treat isolated symptoms—we uncover the deeper imbalance affecting your daily comfort.

[Learn More](/services/general-dentistry/neuromuscular-dentistry)

03

### Sleep Apnea Treatment

Our approach to sleep apnea treatment focuses on restoring your body’s natural rhythm through non-invasive, custom oral appliances. No machines, no noise.

[Learn More](/services/general-dentistry/sleep-apnea-treatment)

04

### Dental Cleanings & Exams

Cleanings and exams are tailored with purpose—to help you feel confident, cared for, and informed at every stage of your health journey.

[Learn More](/services/general-dentistry/dental-cleanings-exams)

05

### Fluoride Treatment

It’s a small addition that supports long-term health and helps preserve the smile you already enjoy.

[Learn More](/services/general-dentistry/fluoride-treatment)

06

### Dental Sealants

It’s a simple step that supports long-term oral health and helps preserve the smile you already have.

[Learn More](/services/general-dentistry/dental-sealants)

07

### Sedation Dentistry

Treatment becomes calm, time feels shorter, and the experience fades into the background allowing you to focus on how life feels afterward.

[Learn More](/services/general-dentistry/sedation-dentistry)

08

### Bruxism Treatment

We focus on the root cause, combining advanced diagnostics with personalized care to help you sleep better, live more comfortably, and wake up without tension.

[Learn More](/services/general-dentistry/bruxism-treatment)

09

### Snore Guards

We offer custom snore guards designed to open the airway and minimize nighttime noise, helping you (and your partner) wake up feeling more restored.

[Learn More](/services/general-dentistry/snore-guards)

10

### Halitosis Dentistry

We offer discreet and effective halitosis dentistry that uncovers the source of odor and treats it at the root. Because freshness should feel effortless.

[Learn More](/services/general-dentistry/halitosis-dentistry)

11

### Oral Cancer Screening

Early detection is critical, and when caught in the earliest stages, treatment outcomes improve dramatically.

[Learn More](/services/general-dentistry/oral-cancer-screening)

12

### Occlusal & Sports Mouthguards

Every design is tailored to your anatomy, needs, and daily habits.

[Learn More](/services/general-dentistry/occlusal-sports-mouthguards)

13

### Dental Technology

Our practice blends refined surroundings with advanced tools, allowing us to deliver accurate, minimally invasive dentistry with greater ease for you.

[Learn More](/services/general-dentistry/dental-technology)

[Image: Dr. Kevin Winters]

FOUNDING DIRECTOR

Dr. Kevin Winters

LVI Clinical Instructor & Aesthetic Master

THE EXPERT DIFFERENCE

## More Than a Cleaning—It’s a Partnership

Our general dentistry services are shaped by the knowledge and leadership of [Dr. Kevin Winters](/about/meet-the-doctor), whose extensive background in neuromuscular and aesthetic dentistry ensures that no detail is overlooked. Every touchpoint in your visit—from the aromatherapy to the precision technology—supports an experience that’s built around you.

We don’t operate like a volume clinic. Our care is unhurried and highly individualized. Whether you’re a longtime patient or visiting for the first time, your goals guide the process. This is dental care that fits seamlessly into a life well lived.

TAKE THE FIRST STEP

## Book Your Preventive Visit Today

Even the most advanced cosmetic or restorative outcomes rely on a strong foundation of oral health. Whether you’re looking for long-term maintenance or need support for a specific concern, we offer general dental care that is thoughtful, comprehensive, and quietly exceptional.

# Occlusal & Sports Mouthguards in Austin, TX

Custom Protection That Works With You

Preservation is a form of luxury. At [**The Hills Dental Spa**](/about), we offer custom-made mouthguards that fit your life—whether you're protecting your smile on the field or preserving your bite while you sleep. Every design is tailored to your anatomy, needs, and daily habits.

Comfort, clarity, and confidence—day or night.

## Designed for Precision and Comfort

There’s no one-size-fits-all when it comes to protecting your teeth. Our custom mouthguards are created from precise digital impressions, ensuring a secure, lightweight fit that supports function without distraction.

We provide two primary types:

* ◆ **Occlusal Mouthguards** – Worn during sleep to protect teeth from grinding and clenching (bruxism). These guards can also help manage tension in the jaw and reduce discomfort associated with misaligned bites.
* ◆ **Sports Mouthguards** – Designed for athletes of all ages, these guards cushion impact during high-contact activities, reducing the risk of dental trauma, fractures, or soft tissue injuries.

Each guard is fabricated to offer durability, breathability, and a barely-there feel that allows you to focus on movement or rest—not your appliance.

## Preventative, Personalized, Protective

A custom-fitted mouthguard isn’t just more comfortable—it’s significantly more effective than over-the-counter alternatives. Whether it’s minimizing wear from nightly grinding or shielding teeth during competition, the goal is the same: lasting protection with minimal interference.

We proudly offer occlusal and athletic mouthguards to patients throughout Austin, West Lake Hills, Rollingwood, Lost Creek, and Lakeway, TX, as part of our broader focus on prevention and wellness.

All appliances are overseen by [**Dr. Kevin Winters**](/about/meet-the-doctor), whose expertise ensures optimal fit, performance, and long-term comfort.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is the difference between an occlusal guard and a sports mouthguard?


Occlusal guards protect against grinding during sleep. Sports mouthguards absorb physical impact during athletic activity. Both are customized to your needs.

### Can I buy a mouthguard at the drugstore instead?


Over-the-counter guards often lack the fit and effectiveness of custom versions. Ill-fitting guards can be uncomfortable or even harmful over time.

### How long does a custom mouthguard last?


With proper care, most mouthguards last several years. However, changes in bite or wear may require periodic replacement or adjustments.

### Is an occlusal guard the same as a night guard?


Yes. Both terms describe guards worn during sleep to protect teeth from nighttime grinding and clenching.

## Guard What Matters Most

Whether it’s the stillness of sleep or the intensity of performance, a custom mouthguard supports what you value. At The Hills Dental Spa, we make protection seamless—so you can stay focused on life, not your teeth.

Call The Hills Dental Spa at [**(512) 347-0044**](tel:+15123470044) or [**request an appointment**](/contact-us) to get fitted for your custom mouthguard.

A conversation—not just a chart review—about your goals, past dental experiences, and expectations.

02

A full set of [digital X-rays](/services/general-dentistry/dental-technology) or scans to evaluate your dental and skeletal health.

A comprehensive exam with [Dr. Kevin Winters](/about/meet-the-doctor), who will walk you through every finding and option with clarity.

04

Discussion of timelines, fees, and financing—always tailored to your pace.

01

### Fee-for-Service

**The Hills Dental Spa is a 100% fee-for-service practice.** This means we are not in-network with any dental insurance providers. Instead, we focus solely on what’s best for your care, without limitations or outside influence.

02

### Out-of-Network

Many of our patients choose to use out-of-network benefits by filing with their insurance provider directly.

03

### Financing Options

We offer third-party financing options through:

* CareCredit
* Cherry
* Proceed Finance

04

### Pre-Qualification

Our team will assist with pre-qualification and help you find the best fit for your treatment and financial goals.

Our spa environment is built around your comfort—not just during treatments, but throughout your time with us. To elevate your experience, we provide curated aromatherapy and calming scents, streaming entertainment in private suites, heated neck rolls, weighted blankets, and professional on-site massage support.

*Discover the philosophy behind The Hills Dental Spa in Austin, TX. Personalized dental care in a spa-like setting, led by Dr. Kevin Winters.*


[Image: The Hills Dental Spa Experience]

— RETURNING TO YOURSELF

# About The Hills Dental Spa

A Spa-Like Dental Experience, Designed for How You Want to Feel

PERSONAL CARE REIMAGINED

**The Hills Dental Spa** was never meant to feel like a typical dental office—because we don’t believe your care should feel typical. Here, every detail is curated to deliver a uniquely personal, restorative, and elevated experience. From the moment you arrive, you’ll sense the difference: a quieter space, a warmer welcome, and a practice built entirely around your comfort and goals.

Patients from Austin, West Lake Hills, Rollingwood, Lost Creek, and Lakeway, TX trust us not only with their smiles—but with their stories, their time, and their long-term health.

OUR APPROACH

## Clinical Excellence & Patient Experience Are Inseparable

At The Hills Dental Spa, clinical excellence and patient experience are inseparable. We offer advanced care in
[cosmetic dentistry](/services/cosmetic-dentistry),
[TMJ therapy](/services/general-dentistry/tmj-therapy), and
[neuromuscular dentistry](/services/general-dentistry/neuromuscular-dentistry),
with precision diagnostics and an individualized, fee-for-service model that keeps your needs—not insurance limitations—at the center of every decision.

“Patients often tell us that their lives change here—not just their teeth. That’s exactly the point.”

MASTERY, WITHOUT DISPLAY

## Meet Dr. Kevin Winters

Program Director, LVI Global

Guiding each experience is **Dr. Kevin Winters**, whose work has influenced thousands of clinicians globally in the fields of aesthetic and neuromuscular dentistry. His approach is deliberate, exacting, and quietly obsessive in its pursuit of precision—where function and beauty are never treated as separate ideas.

Dr. Winters is not just a practitioner; he is an educator. As a featured speaker and clinical instructor at the Las Vegas Institute for Advanced Dental Studies (LVI), he has spent decades teaching other dentists the art and science of smile design and full-mouth reconstruction.

At The Hills Dental Spa, he brings this level of world-class expertise to a private, boutique setting, ensuring that every crown, veneer, and treatment plan is executed with master-level precision.

[EXPLORE THE ATELIER](/about/virtual-tour)

[Image: Dr. Kevin Winters, DDS]

THE ATELIER EXPERIENCE

## Our Space

The ambiance at The Hills Dental Spa was designed with intention. Aromatherapy, soft lighting, heated blankets, weighted comforts, and streaming entertainment are only part of what makes your visit feel relaxed. Every treatment room is private, every interaction unrushed. We even offer in-house massage therapy to enhance the restorative nature of your experience.

This isn’t just dentistry. It’s personal care—reimagined.

[Image: The Hills Dental Spa Elegant Exterior]

[Image: Atelier Calm Consultation Lounge]

[Image: Sensory Spa Treatments Room]

[Image: The Hills Dental Spa Elegant Operatory]

[Virtual Atelier Tour](/about/virtual-tour) [Request Your Visit](/contact-us)

[Image: The Hills Dental Spa Team]

CLINICAL NURTURE & CARE

## A Team That Makes the Experience Whole

Our highly trained team is committed to more than dentistry. Each member is selected for their skill, empathy, and dedication to service. Ongoing clinical education, advanced communication training, and a culture of excellence ensure your care is not only clinically sound—but deeply personal.

Whether you’re here for [veneers](/services/cosmetic-dentistry/porcelain-veneers), [sleep apnea treatment](/services/general-dentistry/sleep-apnea-treatment), or a complete [full mouth reconstruction](/services/restorative-dentistry/full-mouth-reconstruction), you’ll experience care built around who you are—not just what you need.

01

### Continuous Training

Ongoing clinical education and advanced communication certifications ensure our support is highly precise and deeply respectful.

02

### Empathy Selected

Every doctor and dental assistant is chosen for clinical dexterity and deep, active empathy to eliminate treatment anxieties.

03

### A Legacy of Service

A culture built to deliver unhurried, tailored support, ensuring that everything revolves around your comfort.

BEGIN YOUR ELEVATED EXPERIENCE

## Ready to Experience It for Yourself?

The first step is a conversation. We’ll guide you through every detail, every question, and every possibility with clarity and care.

[Request Your Appointment](/contact-us)  |  [(512) 347-0044](tel:+15123470044)

# Dental Implants in Austin, TX

A Permanent Foundation for What Comes Next

Tooth loss can interrupt more than your bite—it can shift the way you speak, eat, and smile. At [**The Hills Dental Spa**](/about), dental implants offer a grounded, lasting solution designed to feel like nothing was ever missing. This is restoration that returns your freedom, without compromise.

Each implant is more than a replacement—it’s the start of something stable, confident, and new.

## What Are Dental Implants?

A dental implant is a titanium post placed into the jawbone to serve as a new root for a missing tooth. Once integrated, it supports a custom crown, bridge, or denture—creating a replacement that looks and functions like a natural tooth.

Dental implants may be recommended for:

* ◆ Single or multiple missing teeth
* ◆ Support for [**Dental Bridges**](/services/restorative-dentistry/dental-bridges) or full-arch restorations
* ◆ Replacing a failing tooth that cannot be saved
* ◆ Providing stability for [**Implant-Supported Dentures**](/services/restorative-dentistry/implant-supported-dentures)
* ◆ Patients seeking a long-term, fixed alternative to removable solutions

The result is a restoration that doesn’t shift, doesn’t limit your lifestyle, and doesn’t feel like a replacement.

## Designed to Blend In. Built to Last.

What sets dental implants apart is their ability to preserve both aesthetics and function. Implants help maintain jawbone health and facial structure while restoring your ability to eat, speak, and smile naturally. We offer advanced dental implant solutions for patients throughout Austin, West Lake Hills, Rollingwood, Lost Creek, and Lakeway, TX.

Your implant restoration is customized for alignment, shape, and tone. Once the implant is placed and healed, we complete the process with a beautifully matched [**porcelain or ceramic crown**](/services/restorative-dentistry/dental-crowns).

Implants may also be incorporated into a broader [**Full Mouth Reconstruction**](/services/restorative-dentistry/full-mouth-reconstruction) plan for patients with more complex needs.

Treatment is carefully planned and executed under the expertise of [**Dr. Kevin Winters**](/about/meet-the-doctor), ensuring that every phase—from planning to placement—aligns with your long-term health and aesthetic goals.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How long do dental implants last?


With proper care, dental implants can last decades—often a lifetime. Routine hygiene and regular checkups help ensure longevity.

### Do dental implants look natural?


Yes. Once restored with a custom crown or bridge, your implant is designed to blend seamlessly with your smile.

### Is the procedure painful?


The implant procedure is performed with comfort in mind. Most patients experience minimal discomfort and are surprised by how easy recovery can be.

### Am I a candidate for implants?


If you’re in good general and oral health with adequate bone support, you’re likely a candidate. A consultation will confirm if implants are right for you.

## A Stronger Smile Starts Here

Dental implants restore more than teeth—they bring stability back to your life. At The Hills Dental Spa, your restoration is crafted to feel natural, last long, and let you move forward without hesitation.

Call The Hills Dental Spa at [**(512) 347-0044**](tel:+15123470044) or [**request an appointment**](/contact-us) to explore your personalized dental implant options.

mainEntity.name: How long do dental implants last?

acceptedAnswer.text: With proper care, dental implants can last decades—often a lifetime. Routine hygiene and regular checkups help ensure longevity.

mainEntity.name: Do dental implants look natural?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Once restored with a custom crown or bridge, your implant is designed to blend seamlessly with your smile.

mainEntity.name: Is the procedure painful?

acceptedAnswer.text: The implant procedure is performed with comfort in mind. Most patients experience minimal discomfort and are surprised by how easy recovery can be.

mainEntity.name: Am I a candidate for implants?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you’re in good general and oral health with adequate bone support, you’re likely a candidate. A consultation will confirm if implants are right for you.

# Cosmetic Dentistry in Austin, TX

OUR PHILOSOPHY

## Elevating Smiles with a Purpose

At [The Hills Dental Spa](/about), cosmetic dentistry goes far beyond surface beauty. Each treatment is part of a tailored approach to help you feel confident, youthful, and in alignment with the life you want to lead. Whether you're seeking subtle refinements or a full smile transformation, we deliver results rooted in both form and function.

Our cosmetic dentistry philosophy is grounded in the belief that aesthetic enhancements should never compromise health or comfort. Each service is selected and customized to suit your facial structure, bite, and long-term goals—creating a look that is uniquely yours. We welcome cosmetic dentistry patients from Austin, West Lake Hills, Rollingwood, Lost Creek, and Lakeway, TX who are seeking a personalized, elevated experience.

Every smile has a story. We’re here to help shape yours with precise, high-end solutions designed to restore balance, symmetry, and brilliance.

Explore our full suite of **cosmetic dentistry treatments**, each backed by experience and technology:

### Porcelain Veneers

Transform your smile with custom-made veneers that provide both strength and beauty.

[Learn More](/services/cosmetic-dentistry/porcelain-veneers)

02

### Prepless Dental Veneers

A conservative alternative to traditional veneers, this treatment enhances your smile with minimal to no enamel reduction.

[Learn More](/services/cosmetic-dentistry/prepless-dental-veneers)

03

### Smile Makeovers

A personalized combination of procedures curated to achieve comprehensive aesthetic transformation in both smile and facial harmony.

[Learn More](/services/cosmetic-dentistry/smile-makeovers)

04

### Teeth Whitening

Designed for dramatic results, this in-office treatment lifts years of staining to reveal a visibly brighter smile in a single visit.

[Learn More](/services/cosmetic-dentistry/teeth-whitening)

05

### Veneer Restoration

Whether you're experiencing discoloration, chipping, or poor fit, we offer expert restoration to bring your veneers back to life.

[Learn More](/services/cosmetic-dentistry/veneer-restoration)

06

### Lumineers & Laminates

These ultra-thin shells offer an effective, non-invasive option for reshaping and whitening teeth.

07

### Dental Bonding

A cost-effective and quick fix for minor imperfections, dental bonding uses tooth-colored resin for seamless repairs.

08

### Invisalign

Straighten teeth discreetly and comfortably with this clear aligner system, offering a convenient alternative to braces.

### Clear Aligners

Suitable for mild to moderate alignment concerns, clear aligners offer flexibility and predictable results with minimal lifestyle disruption.

### Chipped & Cracked Tooth Repair

We restore structural integrity and aesthetics with customized treatments that blend naturally with the surrounding teeth.

[Learn More](/services/cosmetic-dentistry/chipped-cracked-tooth-repair)

### Gummy Smile Treatment

Adjust gum contours to reveal more tooth surface, creating a more proportionate and attractive smile line.

[Learn More](/services/cosmetic-dentistry/gummy-smile-treatment)

— OUR SERVICES

# Prepless Dental Veneers in Austin, TX

Effortless Beauty Without Compromise

For those seeking a subtle transformation without altering their natural teeth, prepless veneers offer a refined alternative. At [**The Hills Dental Spa**](/about), this service is ideal for patients who want a lighter touch—something that enhances, not replaces. With no enamel removal and no downtime, the result is an upgraded version of your natural smile, preserved in full.

This is dentistry designed for people who appreciate simplicity, elegance, and the power of small changes to create lasting impact.

## What Sets Prepless Veneers Apart

Prepless veneers are ultra-thin shells of ceramic bonded to the front of your teeth—without the need for reshaping or drilling. The treatment is minimally invasive, yet the aesthetic shift can be significant. They're designed to blend with your existing teeth, offering symmetry, brightness, and balance with a softer, more conservative approach.

They may be ideal for:

* ◆ Minor chips or discoloration
* ◆ Narrow smiles or undersized teeth
* ◆ Small gaps or uneven edges
* ◆ Patients who want reversibility or a less invasive alternative to traditional veneers

At The Hills Dental Spa, every case is evaluated for facial harmony and natural fit. The goal isn’t to create a different version of you—it’s to elevate the one already there.

## Designed Around You

Prepless veneers aren’t just about skipping a step. They’re about keeping what’s already working, and refining what’s not. Your smile is designed based on the curvature of your lips, the tone of your skin, and the way you carry yourself.

Our team partners with leading ceramic artists to produce veneers that are lightweight, translucent, and nearly indistinguishable from real enamel. Placement is precise. The look is subtle. The result is lasting.

This service is guided by [**Dr. Kevin Winters**](/about/meet-the-doctor), whose experience in cosmetic and neuromuscular dentistry ensures that aesthetics never come at the expense of comfort or function. Patients from Austin, West Lake Hills, Rollingwood, Lost Creek, and Lakeway, TX choose us for prepless veneers that protect and elevate their natural smiles.

## The Quiet Confidence of a Smile That Fits

You don’t have to choose between conservative treatment and meaningful change. Prepless veneers are for those who understand that beauty doesn’t need to be loud—it just needs to feel aligned. This is the kind of dentistry that doesn’t draw attention to itself, but changes how you move through the world.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How are prepless veneers different from traditional veneers?


Prepless veneers require no removal of enamel, making them a more conservative option. They are ideal for patients whose teeth already have the right shape and alignment but need refinement in color or proportion.

### Are prepless veneers reversible?


Because they don’t involve reshaping your natural teeth, prepless veneers are typically reversible. However, this depends on the individual case, and we’ll discuss long-term considerations during your consultation.

### Do prepless veneers look as natural as porcelain veneers?


Yes. They are made from high-quality, ultra-thin ceramic that mimics the translucency and luster of natural enamel. The key is in the customization, which we tailor to suit your features and goals.

### Who is a good candidate for prepless veneers?


Ideal candidates have minimal alignment issues and healthy enamel. Prepless veneers work best for patients seeking subtle aesthetic enhancement without structural changes to their teeth.

## Begin Subtly. Feel the Shift.

When you're ready for a smile upgrade that doesn't require a full commitment to traditional veneers, Prepless Dental Veneers may be the right step. The process is simple. The results speak quietly but carry weight.

Call The Hills Dental Spa at [**(512) 347-0044**](tel:+15123470044) or [**request an appointment**](/contact-us) to learn if prepless veneers are the right fit for you.

The first step is a conversation. We’ll guide you through every detail, every question, and every possibility with clarity and care.

mainEntity.name: How are prepless veneers different from traditional veneers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Prepless veneers require no removal of enamel, making them a more conservative option. They are ideal for patients whose teeth already have the right shape and alignment but need refinement in color or proportion.

mainEntity.name: Are prepless veneers reversible?

acceptedAnswer.text: Because they don’t involve reshaping your natural teeth, prepless veneers are typically reversible. However, this depends on the individual case, and we’ll discuss long-term considerations during your consultation.

mainEntity.name: Do prepless veneers look as natural as porcelain veneers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. They are made from high-quality, ultra-thin ceramic that mimics the translucency and luster of natural enamel. The key is in the customization, which we tailor to suit your features and goals.

mainEntity.name: Who is a good candidate for prepless veneers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ideal candidates have minimal alignment issues and healthy enamel. Prepless veneers work best for patients seeking subtle aesthetic enhancement without structural changes to their teeth.

— LEGAL

# Accessibility Statement

*Effective Date: July 30, 2026*

## 1. Our Commitment

This dental practice is committed to ensuring digital accessibility for all visitors, including individuals with disabilities. We have invested in the design and development of this website with the goal of providing an accessible and usable experience for all users, and we are continually working to maintain and improve the accessibility of this website.

## 2. Accessibility Standards

This website has been designed with accessibility in mind and targets conformance with the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 Level AA, as published by the World Wide Web Consortium (W3C). These guidelines define how to make web content more accessible to people with a wide range of disabilities, including visual, auditory, physical, speech, cognitive, language, learning, and neurological disabilities.

# Implant-Supported Dentures in Austin, TX

Secure Comfort. Complete Confidence.

Traditional dentures often shift, limit your bite, or feel like something to manage. At [**The Hills Dental Spa**](/about), implant-supported dentures offer a refined, modern alternative—one that delivers the permanence and ease of natural teeth, with the added security of a fixed foundation.

This is restoration designed not just to replace, but to restore the rhythm of your everyday life. Patients in Austin, West Lake Hills, Rollingwood, Lost Creek, and Lakeway, TX trust us for secure, functional implant-supported dentures.

## What Are Implant-Supported Dentures?

Implant-supported dentures are custom prosthetics that attach to dental implants placed in the jawbone. Unlike removable dentures, they stay in place—creating a stable, comfortable, and natural-feeling solution for full-arch tooth loss.

You may be a candidate if:

* ◆ You’ve lost most or all teeth on the upper or lower arch
* ◆ You want a secure, non-removable alternative to traditional dentures
* ◆ You’ve experienced discomfort or looseness with removable prosthetics
* ◆ You want to preserve jawbone health and facial structure
* ◆ You’re looking for a long-term solution with improved bite function

By integrating directly with the jaw, implant-supported dentures restore more than just the appearance of your smile—they provide the strength to eat, speak, and laugh without hesitation.

## Custom Fit. Secure Design.

Each restoration begins with a comprehensive plan. After placing a series of implants, we design your custom denture to attach securely to them—achieving a precise fit and natural aesthetic.

Implant-supported dentures can be:

* ◆ **Fixed** – attached permanently to implants for maximum security
* ◆ **Removable by the dentist** – cleaned or adjusted as needed
* ◆ Crafted from high-quality materials for lifelike translucency and durability

In some cases, this treatment may be part of a [**Full Mouth Reconstruction**](/services/restorative-dentistry/full-mouth-reconstruction) to restore overall function and appearance. Implant dentures can also be combined with other services, including [**Dental Implants**](/services/restorative-dentistry/dental-implants) and [**Dental Crowns**](/services/restorative-dentistry/dental-crowns) when needed.

Your treatment is led by [**Dr. Kevin Winters**](/about/meet-the-doctor), whose experience in advanced restorative procedures ensures that every decision is guided by long-term comfort, function, and beauty.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Are implant-supported dentures comfortable?


Yes. They’re designed to feel secure and natural, with none of the movement or irritation often associated with traditional dentures.

### How many implants are needed?


Typically, 4 to 6 implants per arch are used to support a full denture. Your exact treatment plan will be tailored to your anatomy and needs.

### Can I eat normally with them?


Absolutely. These restorations restore near-full bite function, allowing you to enjoy a wider range of foods without discomfort or instability.

### Is this the same as All-on-4?


All-on-4 is a type of implant-supported denture. We offer several configurations and will determine which is right for you during your consultation.

## Reclaim Strength. Rediscover Ease.

Implant-supported dentures offer more than stability—they restore trust in every part of your smile. At The Hills Dental Spa, we create prosthetics that don’t feel like replacements, but like part of you.

Call The Hills Dental Spa at [**(512) 347-0044**](tel:+15123470044) or [**request an appointment**](/contact-us) to explore implant-supported options for complete, secure restoration.

# Veneer Restoration in Austin, TX

When the Smile Needs Refinement, Not Reinvention

Over time, even the best dental veneers may begin to show signs of wear. Discoloration, minor fractures, shifting, or outdated aesthetics can quietly take away from the original impact of your smile. At [**The Hills Dental Spa**](/about), veneer restoration is a curated process of renewal—focused not on starting over, but on returning your smile to its intended brilliance.

We treat every case as a continuation, not a correction. The goal is to refine, refresh, and restore harmony—so your smile feels like yours again.

## Why Veneers Need Restoration

Veneers are designed to be durable, but time, habits, and even changes in your facial structure can affect how they look and perform. Restoration may be necessary if you notice:

* ◆ Cracks or chips
* ◆ Discoloration or staining at the edges
* ◆ Separation from the gumline
* ◆ Changes in bite or alignment
* ◆ Outdated shape or design

Many patients come to us feeling unsure about how to move forward. They want their smile back, but without compromising the work they’ve already invested in. That’s where we come in.

## Precision Reimagined

Veneer restoration at The Hills Dental Spa begins with an in-depth evaluation of your existing veneers, bite function, and facial symmetry. We look at what’s working and what’s not—then design a plan to improve the aesthetics and performance without overcorrecting.

Depending on your case, restoration may include:

* ◆ Replacing individual veneers
* ◆ Adjusting or refining veneer shape
* ◆ Upgrading materials to improve longevity and appearance
* ◆ Realigning the bite or contouring to restore balance
* ◆ Enhancing color to better match your natural features

Every detail is approached with care, and every restoration is handled with the intention of making your smile feel natural, not manufactured.

This service is led by [**Dr. Kevin Winters**](/about/meet-the-doctor), whose expertise in cosmetic and neuromuscular dentistry allows for deeper insight into the relationship between aesthetics and function. We welcome patients from Austin, West Lake Hills, Rollingwood, Lost Creek, and Lakeway, TX seeking expert veneer restoration.

## When Your Smile Evolves, Your Dentistry Should Too

Veneers don’t just change your appearance—they shape your expression, your confidence, and how you carry yourself. As your life shifts, your smile should be able to evolve with it.

Restoring veneers is about honoring that evolution with subtlety and skill.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How do I know if my veneers need restoration?


Common signs include visible wear, chips, discoloration at the edges, or a feeling that your smile no longer fits naturally. We can assess whether minor adjustments or full replacement is needed.

### Can just one veneer be restored, or do they all need replacing?


In many cases, individual veneers can be repaired or replaced without affecting the rest. We’ll evaluate the aesthetics and functionality of your full smile before making a recommendation.

### Will restored veneers look different from my original ones?


Only in the best way. Our goal is a seamless match or an intentional upgrade, depending on your vision. Modern materials allow for improved translucency, durability, and fit.

### How long does veneer restoration take?


It depends on the number of veneers and the complexity of the case. Most restorations can be completed over a few visits, with minimal disruption to your routine.

## Reconnect with Your Smile

You don’t need a full reinvention to feel like yourself again. Veneer restoration at The Hills Dental Spa offers a precise, elegant solution for those ready to refine what they already have.

Call The Hills Dental Spa at [**(512) 347-0044**](tel:+15123470044) or [**request an appointment**](/contact-us) to explore your options.

*Treat sleep apnea without CPAP in Austin, TX. Discover custom oral appliance therapy at The Hills Dental Spa.*


[Image: Sleep Apnea Treatment at The Hills Dental Spa in Austin, TX]

— OUR SERVICES

# Sleep Apnea Treatment in Austin, TX

A Quiet Night Can Change Everything

Interrupted sleep isn’t just tiring, it affects every part of your life: your energy, your focus, your mood, and over time, your long-term health. At [**The Hills Dental Spa**](/about), our approach to sleep apnea treatment focuses on restoring your body’s natural rhythm through non-invasive, custom oral appliances. No machines, no noise, just a subtle shift that lets your body breathe and rest the way it’s meant to.

For many patients, this is the first treatment they’ve actually been able to stick with. If you’ve tried [**CPAP and found it difficult to tolerate**](/blog/cpap-alternative-austin), you’re far from alone, and an oral appliance may be the alternative you’ve been looking for.

It’s not just about better sleep. It’s about better living.

## Understanding Obstructive Sleep Apnea

Obstructive Sleep Apnea (OSA) occurs when the airway becomes blocked during sleep—typically by the soft tissues at the back of the throat. This blockage disrupts airflow, causes repeated pauses in breathing, and forces your body to wake frequently throughout the night, often without you realizing it.

Common symptoms include:

* ◆ Loud, chronic snoring
* ◆ Waking up gasping for air
* ◆ Daytime fatigue or irritability
* ◆ Morning headaches
* ◆ Poor concentration or memory loss
* ◆ Dry mouth or sore throat in the morning

These symptoms are often dismissed as ordinary tiredness or stress, which is part of why sleep apnea frequently goes undiagnosed for years. If a partner has mentioned your snoring or noticed you stop breathing during sleep, that observation is often the first real clue, and it’s worth taking seriously.

Left untreated, sleep apnea can lead to serious health risks including high blood pressure, heart disease, and metabolic disorders.

## A Non-Invasive Alternative to CPAP

At The Hills Dental Spa, we provide a more comfortable, patient-preferred option: a custom oral appliance designed to reposition the jaw slightly forward during sleep. This keeps the airway open—reducing snoring and preventing apnea episodes—without the need for a CPAP machine.

Our sleep apnea treatment is:

* ◆ **Custom-fit** to your bite and jaw alignment
* ◆ **Quiet and portable**, ideal for travel
* ◆ **Comfortable and discreet**, making long-term use easier
* ◆ **Non-surgical**, requiring no invasive procedures
* ◆ Often combined with [**TMJ Therapy**](/services/general-dentistry/tmj-therapy) or [**Neuromuscular Dentistry**](/services/general-dentistry/neuromuscular-dentistry) when bite misalignment is a contributing factor

If you’ve already been diagnosed through a sleep study but have struggled with CPAP, that diagnosis can typically serve as your starting point, there’s no need to begin the process over.

Your treatment is guided by [**Dr. Kevin Winters**](/about/meet-the-doctor), who combines clinical precision with a holistic understanding of how the jaw, airway, and sleep quality are connected. We offer sleep apnea treatment options to patients in Austin, West Lake Hills, Rollingwood, Lost Creek, and Lakeway, TX.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Can an oral appliance replace my CPAP machine?


For many patients, especially those with mild to moderate obstructive sleep apnea or anyone who is CPAP-intolerant, yes. A sleep study helps confirm whether an oral appliance is an appropriate primary treatment for your specific case.

### Is oral appliance therapy effective for all sleep apnea cases?


It is most effective for mild to moderate obstructive sleep apnea or for patients who are CPAP-intolerant. A sleep study will determine if you’re a good candidate.

### Is the appliance comfortable?


Yes. It’s custom designed to fit your mouth and support natural jaw positioning. Most patients adjust quickly and find it far more tolerable than CPAP.

### Will this stop my snoring?


In many cases, yes. By keeping the airway open, the oral appliance reduces or eliminates snoring caused by tissue vibration in the throat.

### How do I get started?


You’ll begin with a consultation and medical history review. If needed, we’ll coordinate with your physician for a sleep study before designing your custom appliance.

### Do I need a new sleep study if I already have one?


Not necessarily. If you’ve already been diagnosed with sleep apnea, that information is typically enough to begin evaluating you for oral appliance therapy.

### Is oral appliance therapy covered differently than CPAP?

# Invisalign in Austin, TX

Subtle Shifts That Redefine Confidence

The beauty of Invisalign lies in its quiet transformation. At [**The Hills Dental Spa**](/about), we offer this nearly invisible orthodontic option to patients who want to move through life uninterrupted—refining their smile without the feeling of being in treatment.

It’s discreet, precise, and designed to align with both your schedule and your lifestyle.

## What Invisalign Can Do

Invisalign uses a series of clear, custom-fit aligners to gradually shift your teeth into better alignment. No brackets. No wires. Just a smooth, minimal approach that allows your natural confidence to stay front and center.

It’s a strong fit for patients who want to address:

* ◆ Crowded or overlapping teeth
* ◆ Gaps or spacing
* ◆ Minor bite irregularities
* ◆ Shifting after previous orthodontic work
* ◆ A more symmetrical and balanced smile

Each set of aligners is worn for a prescribed amount of time before moving to the next. Most people won’t notice you’re wearing them—but you’ll feel the progress with every change.

## Designed to Fit You

This is not a one-size-fits-all experience. We begin with a digital scan to map your current alignment and visualize your projected results. From there, a personalized plan is created—calibrated to move each tooth with control and efficiency.

Your comfort, timing, and preferences shape every part of the process.

This service is overseen by [**Dr. Kevin Winters**](/about/meet-the-doctor), whose background in advanced cosmetic and neuromuscular dentistry ensures your treatment supports not only aesthetics but long-term balance and function.

Invisalign can also complement other smile enhancements, such as [**Teeth Whitening**](/services/cosmetic-dentistry/teeth-whitening) or [**Dental Bonding**](/services/cosmetic-dentistry/dental-bonding), as part of a complete, personalized smile plan. We provide Invisalign to patients in Austin, West Lake Hills, Rollingwood, Lost Creek, and Lakeway, TX who want discreet, functional alignment.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How long does Invisalign treatment take?


Treatment time varies depending on your specific case. Many patients see full results within 6 to 18 months, with noticeable improvements much sooner.

### Can I eat and drink normally with Invisalign?


Yes. Aligners are removed when eating or drinking anything other than water, allowing you to enjoy your usual meals without restrictions.

### How often do I need to wear the aligners?


For optimal results, wear your aligners 20–22 hours per day, removing them only to eat, drink, brush, and floss.

### Is Invisalign as effective as traditional braces?


In many cases, yes. Invisalign is effective for mild to moderate alignment concerns and offers the added benefit of discretion and comfort.

## Move Differently

Invisalign isn’t about dramatic before-and-after moments—it’s about feeling more aligned in your own skin, one day at a time. Clear, quiet, and custom-fit to your life, it’s a shift you’ll feel long before the final result.

Call The Hills Dental Spa at [**(512) 347-0044**](tel:+15123470044) or [**request an appointment**](/contact-us) to begin your Invisalign consultation.

— OUR SERVICES

# Smile Makeovers in Austin, TX

A New Smile. A New Way of Living.

A smile makeover at [**The Hills Dental Spa**](/about) is not about perfection. It’s about alignment—between who you are and how you show up in the world. Whether you’re ready to shed the weight of self-consciousness or simply want your outer appearance to reflect your inner confidence, a customized smile makeover offers a refined, intentional transformation.

This isn’t cosmetic dentistry in the traditional sense. It’s a personalized experience designed to elevate not just how you look—but how you feel.

## What Is a Smile Makeover?

A smile makeover is a tailored combination of treatments used to address multiple aesthetic or functional concerns. No two are the same. Each one is built around your goals, facial features, and how your teeth interact with your expression, speech, and confidence.

Your makeover may include:

* ◆ [**Porcelain Veneers**](/services/cosmetic-dentistry/porcelain-veneers) to create uniformity and symmetry
* ◆ [**Prepless Dental Veneers**](/services/cosmetic-dentistry/prepless-dental-veneers) for a more conservative refinement
* ◆ [**Teeth Whitening**](/services/cosmetic-dentistry/teeth-whitening) for a brighter, more youthful appearance
* ◆ [**Dental Bonding**](/services/cosmetic-dentistry/dental-bonding) to smooth and correct minor flaws
* ◆ [**Invisalign**](/services/cosmetic-dentistry/invisalign) or [**Clear Aligners**](/services/cosmetic-dentistry/clear-aligners) to discreetly straighten teeth
* ◆ [**Gummy Smile Treatment**](/services/cosmetic-dentistry/gummy-smile-treatment) to improve tooth-to-gum balance

We may also address underlying issues such as bite alignment or tooth wear that could impact both aesthetics and long-term function.

## A Personal, Artistic Process

Each smile makeover begins with a conversation—quiet, thoughtful, and unhurried. We look beyond your teeth and into how your smile fits into your overall presence. Skin tone, lip shape, eye placement, posture, and lifestyle are all considered in the design.

Treatments are staged and sequenced for both comfort and continuity. Nothing is rushed. Every detail is intentional. The goal is to create a smile that feels lived-in, not manufactured—one that reflects the way you already carry yourself, just with more ease.

The entire process is guided by [**Dr. Kevin Winters**](/about/meet-the-doctor), whose advanced training in cosmetic and neuromuscular dentistry ensures that every change supports both beauty and balance. We provide comprehensive smile makeovers to individuals in Austin, West Lake Hills, Rollingwood, Lost Creek, and Lakeway, TX.

## The Impact of Subtle Confidence

A smile makeover isn’t always about dramatic change. Often, it’s a series of subtle shifts that create space for bigger changes in how you engage with life. It’s what happens when you stop worrying about how your smile looks and start focusing on where it can take you.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What’s included in a smile makeover?


Each makeover is personalized, but it may involve a combination of veneers, whitening, bonding, clear aligners, or other cosmetic procedures. We design the plan based on your goals and needs.

### How long does a smile makeover take?


The timeline varies depending on the treatments selected. Some patients complete their makeover in a few weeks, while others spread out treatment over several months for comfort and convenience.

### Is a smile makeover only about looks?


No. While aesthetics are central, we also consider how your teeth function, how your bite aligns, and how the changes will support your long-term oral health.

### Will people know I’ve had dental work done?


Not unless you tell them. The goal is natural-looking results that complement your features—not something that looks artificial or obvious.

## This Is More Than Cosmetic

A smile makeover at The Hills Dental Spa is about creating a version of you that feels complete. It’s not flashy. It’s not fast. It’s carefully considered care for people who know that confidence isn’t a luxury—it’s a foundation.

Custom, natural results at The Hills Dental Spa.* [Image: Dental Crowns at The Hills Dental Spa in Austin, TX] — OUR SERVICES # Dental Crowns in Austin, TX Strength Where It Matters, Beauty Where It Shows When a tooth is damaged, weakened, or worn, the goal is not just to repair—it’s to restore confidence in every moment that follows. At [**The Hills Dental Spa**](/about), dental crowns are designed to blend seamlessly into your smile while offering the stability you need to move forward without hesitation. Every restoration is shaped to reflect the care, quality, and natural aesthetic that defines our approach. ## When a Crown Is the Right Choice A crown is a full-coverage restoration that surrounds the entire visible portion of the tooth, offering both protection and cosmetic improvement. It's often used when a tooth has been structurally compromised, or when prior treatments no longer provide support. A dental crown may be recommended for: * ◆ Cracked or fractured teeth * ◆ Teeth with large fillings or recurrent decay * ◆ Restoration after root canal therapy * ◆ Teeth with significant wear or erosion * ◆ Cosmetic enhancement of misshapen or discolored teeth Each crown is custom-made to match the surrounding teeth in color, shape, and contour—resulting in a restoration that feels invisible in daily life. ## Materials and Options We offer both **porcelain** and **ceramic crowns**, selected based on your needs and the location of the tooth: * ◆ **Porcelain crowns** offer high strength with a beautiful, lifelike appearance—ideal for visible front teeth where aesthetics are paramount. * ◆ **All-ceramic crowns** combine durability with translucency and are often used when metal-free restorations are preferred. In some cases, crowns may be part of a broader treatment plan, such as a [**Full Mouth Reconstruction**](/services/restorative-dentistry/full-mouth-reconstruction) or paired with [**Dental Implants**](/services/restorative-dentistry/dental-implants) to replace a missing tooth entirely. Each case is overseen by [**Dr. Kevin Winters**](/about/meet-the-doctor), whose background in both cosmetic and restorative dentistry ensures a result that is balanced, functional, and timeless. We serve patients throughout Austin, West Lake Hills, Rollingwood, Lost Creek, and Lakeway, TX with porcelain and ceramic dental crowns. ## Frequently Asked Questions ### How long do dental crowns last? With excellent care, crowns can last 10–15 years or more. Regular cleanings and avoiding habits like grinding or chewing on hard objects help extend their lifespan. ### Will the crown match my natural teeth? Yes. We carefully select the material and shade to match your surrounding teeth, ensuring the crown looks and feels like part of your natural smile. ### Is the procedure painful? The process is gentle and typically involves local anesthesia. Most patients experience minimal discomfort and return to normal activities the same day. ### Can crowns improve the look of my smile? Absolutely. In addition to restoring strength, crowns can enhance symmetry, close gaps, and correct discoloration—often as part of a [**Smile Makeover**](/services/cosmetic-dentistry/smile-makeovers). ## Quiet Confidence, Fully Restored A dental crown isn’t just about fixing what’s broken—it’s about restoring the comfort, ease, and self-assurance that comes with a smile you can trust. json_ld.description: Restore strength and beauty with porcelain and ceramic dental crowns in Austin, TX. Custom, natural results at The Hills Dental Spa.

mainEntity.name: How long do dental crowns last?

acceptedAnswer.text: With excellent care, crowns can last 10–15 years or more. Regular cleanings and avoiding habits like grinding or chewing on hard objects help extend their lifespan.

mainEntity.name: Will the crown match my natural teeth?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We carefully select the material and shade to match your surrounding teeth, ensuring the crown looks and feels like part of your natural smile.

mainEntity.name: Is the procedure painful?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process is gentle and typically involves local anesthesia. Most patients experience minimal discomfort and return to normal activities the same day.

mainEntity.name: Can crowns improve the look of my smile?

acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely. In addition to restoring strength, crowns can enhance symmetry, close gaps, and correct discoloration—often as part of a Smile Makeover.
